title: Source-open counit composition triangle
statement: For an open U of X, any j:Y→U, and any homotopy complex P on X, Lj* of the inverse open-pullback comparison, followed by the selected derived composition comparison for j and U inclusion, the composite pinned counit, and the localized termwise comparison from composite tensor pullback to source restriction then tensor pullback, equals Lj* of the exact restriction localization factor followed by the pinned counit for j at restricted P. The termwise comparison is constructed from tensorPullbackCompositionIso and openPinnedTensorOpenIso. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition].

source.place: Tags 08HY, 08DW and 0D5S; derived tensor composition and restriction

proof.text: Evaluate the defining leftDerivedLift equation for the selected composition comparison at Qh(P). Functor.leftDerived_fac_app gives compositionCounit: the selected comparison followed by the composite pinned counit equals the mapped open counit, the pinned counit for j, and the localized ordinary composition comparison.

Use SingleComplexBaseChange.tensor_composition_symm from AffineSpectrumCompositionCounitSquare to identify the ordinary comparison as the inverse tensorPullbackCompositionIso. A proof-only import all makes that existing private lemma available within the same package. For homotopyCompositionComparison choose a representative complex, express both homotopy comparison components as quotient maps, and check their composite in each degree. The ordinary composition and its inverse cancel, leaving tensor pullback of the open tensor comparison. Apply Qh to this equation.

Unfold singleComplexOpenPullbackIso. Its ordinary comparison is the inverse openPinnedTensorOpenIso by associativity. Functor.leftDerivedNatTrans_app evaluates the inverse leftDerivedUnique component followed by the pinned open counit. Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fach then yields openCounit: this composite is the exact restriction localization factor followed by Qh of the inverse termwise open comparison.

Naturality of the pinned counit for j moves Qh of the open tensor comparison across that counit. Map openCounit by derivedPullback j and cancel the inverse and forward termwise open comparisons using NatTrans.mapHomotopyCategory_comp, functoriality, and the isomorphism identity. Substitute these equations into the compositionCounit equation and reassociate (sourceTriangleAlgebra). The result is the stated source-open triangle. No counit is canceled, and no geometric assumption is used.

lean.statement:
theorem open_pinned_source_counit_triangle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (derivedPullback j).map ((singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X U).inv.app
        (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
      (pinnedPullbackComposition.{u, w} j U.ι).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ≫
      (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} (j ≫ U.ι)).app P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopySourceCompositionIso U j).hom.app P) =
    (derivedPullback j).map ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app P) ≫
      (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} j).app
        ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) |>.obj P)
